acceptance: Report runtime identity, liveness, readiness and scheduling progress as separate dimensions. Exact command root, source commit, config hash and PID generation are identity; process and singleton ownership are liveness; task head, queue and provider registry access are readiness; cycle budget, dispatch latency and runnable-backlog service are progress.

Remove the process_alive or lock_held healthy shortcut. A held lock cannot compensate for a mismatched or dead exact runtime process, and a fresh heartbeat cannot compensate for stalled scheduling progress.
Retain PromotionTransaction locking, exact process termination, config CAS, immutable candidate launch, three fresh-loop verification, known-good rollback and durable transaction evidence.

Require immutable active incumbent and immutable known-good rollback roots. Delete mutable incumbent bootstrap, split-entrypoint compatibility, legacy task-brief drift, pycache residue, legacy environment and admission-lock churn branches and their allow_legacy switches after focused provenance tests prove the supported contract.

Promotion postchecks must consume the four-dimensional health contract, exact process generation, task projection, worker/queue/lease parity and provider baseline. Rollback must prove the same contract.

Add failure injection at every promotion state, PID reuse, lock orphan, stale heartbeat, correct heartbeat with no scheduling progress, wrong runtime root, candidate launch failure and rollback launch failure.
Delete obsolete migration classes, helpers, flags and tests in the same PR and report gross/net production line change. Deliver by clean PR, independent exact-head review and required checks.
